name: 5-3-r16

movement.instructions: Apply the first matching rule: (1) enemy_dy < 0 AND enemy_dx <= 64: dodge_left. (2) grounded is true AND lowest_floor_drop_px == 0: run_right. (3) retreating is true AND drop_px < 32 AND lowest_floor_drop_px > 0: brake_left. (4) blocked is true AND wall_height > headroom: brake_left. Otherwise run_right. Null means absent; a comparison to null does not match.

criteria.dodge_left: Step left to avoid a nearby enemy falling from above.

enemy.instructions: Choose C if distance_px <= 48 and vertical_offset_px >= 0. Choose A if distance_px is null. Otherwise choose B.

enemy_low.instructions: Choose C if distance_px <= 40 and vertical_offset_px >= 0. Choose A if distance_px is null. Otherwise choose B.

wall.instructions: Choose A if distance_px is null. Choose C if distance_px <= 48 and (headroom_px is null OR height_px <= headroom_px). Otherwise choose B.

criteria.B: Do not jump at this wall.

pit.instructions: Choose A if distance_px is null. Choose C if distance_px <= 48 and floor_gaps is not empty. Otherwise choose B.

criteria.B: Not time to jump; far away or a safe drop.
criteria.C: Jump over the nearby floor gap.

air.instructions: Which direction is Mario moving vertically?

instructions: Is Mario falling? Answer using the motion field only.

criteria.right_run_jump: No, motion is grounded or rising or airborne.

memory_notes.instructions: OVERRIDE ALL EARLIER QUESTIONS. Use only grounded. Jump if grounded, otherwise release jump.
OVERRIDE the previous movement rules here. If rising, choose left_jump to brake horizontal speed while keeping jump held. Otherwise choose right_run.

criteria.right_run: Mario motion is falling or grounded.

memory_notes.instructions: OVERRIDE: the next platform is much LOWER. Do NOT start a new jump from this high platform. If rising sustain the existing jump. Otherwise run right with jump released and drop onto the lower platform.

criteria.right_run: Grounded or falling: run right without jump.

memory_notes.instructions: OVERRIDE earlier rules. Land near the start of the lower platform. If grounded or rising, jump right. Otherwise if note_elapsed_frames.drop-brake is less than16, brake left without jumping. Otherwise run right without jump.

criteria.left: Airborne/falling and drop-brake elapsed < 16: brake left.
criteria.right_run: Airborne/falling and drop-brake elapsed >= 16: run right.

memory_notes.instructions: OVERRIDE: jump as soon as grounded to reach the left side of the next platform. Grounded or rising: jump right. Falling: run right without jump.
OVERRIDE: use a SHORT jump to land on the moving platform. If grounded jump right. If airborne release jump immediately. If airborne run RIGHT without jump.

criteria.right_run: Not grounded: release jump and run right.

memory_notes.instructions: OVERRIDE: use a medium jump. If grounded, jump right. If rising AND jump_elapsed_frames is less than12, hold jump right. Otherwise release jump and run right.
OVERRIDE: land early before the koopa. If rising hold jump and brake left. Otherwise run right without jump.
Is Mario falling? Jump over the goomba on this high treetop.
Is Mario grounded? Use a short hop over the goomba on this high treetop.
Has landing-brake elapsed less than16 frames? Brake left briefly to land on the lower platform. Then run right.
Is Mario falling? Use a full jump to the next platform.
Classify note_elapsed_frames.ride-platform into one of these three intervals. Ignore all other facts: below 24; from 24 through 139; at least 140.
